text:
leo (partnerships): Heads-up: rough sketch for a partner-led Redwood Dedicated offer to make HW vendors comfortable selling committed capacity. Looking for quick sanity checks.
tara (sales): Lay it out.
leo (partnerships): Core idea: graduated commitment bands (Edge / Scale / Fleet) mapped to reserved GPU-month SKUs. Include an "SI enablement voucher" applied as invoice credit to cover implementation hours. Renewal protection clause + short discount taper.
mike (product): Are bands fixed GPU counts or flexible vCPU/GPU equivalents? We should keep it GPU-month for billing simplicity.
leo (partnerships): keep it GPU-month. bands = Edge(2 GPU-mo), Scale(16 GPU-mo), Fleet(64 GPU-mo). Pricing per GPU-mo with partner uplift share.
nina (solutions): Voucher should be redeemable only for certified SI partners and expire in 120 days. Recommend voucher flow: partner issues voucher code during onboarding -> solutions redeems via console.
omar (finance): Invoice-credit is fine. Need SKU-level mapping to avoid revenue recognition confusion. Voucher redemption should be a separate zero-dollar line with partner tag.
dara (legal): Add non-transferability and anti-fraud verification for voucher. Also call out that marketplace private offers may require provider-specific payload fields (offerCode, planId) and can't pass through third-party credits automatically.
leo (partnerships): Good catch. We'll need marketplace ops to confirm whether private-offer payload can include a partner attribution field or we use our billing mapping after marketplace invoice.
tara (sales): On renewals: customers hate surprise price changes. Can we promise price parity for renewal term unless they change capacity?
leo (partnerships): Proposal: renewal safety-net = same unit price for one renewal term if customer maintains or upsizes. If they downsize, we reprice pro-rata. Also a two-step taper for long tails: Yr2 -4%, Yr3 -1.5%.
mike (product): To support safety-net we need partner attribution persisted on the account and a send-time snapshot of pricing. Console teams: is this feasible?
nina (solutions): We can add a `partner_id` tag on provisioning and store pricing snapshot in billing metadata. Estimate 1 sprint plus a small billing ETL change.
omar (finance): Need to publish a clear invoice sample for partners and customers. Also define voucher burn rules: partial redemptions allowed? I'd say yes, until voucher value exhausted.
dara (legal): Also include force-majeure fallback: if partner hardware allocation is delayed, Redwood can temporarily route to Hosted/Hybrid plan at comparable economics until supply resolves.
marketplace-bot: Note: to list private offers in CloudMarket (GCP/AWS/Azure) you must register offer and provide planId + term. Some partners require additional reseller agreements.
leo (partnerships): Pilot timeline? If legal/finance sign drafts and we prioritize console work, can we pilot in 5 weeks with one strategic OEM partner?
tara (sales): I have a partner that will greenlight pilot. 5 weeks works if pricing sheet and partner SOW are ready in 7 days.
nina (solutions): I'll scope the console bits and share a JIRA ticket today.
omar (finance): I'll draft SKU mapping and sample invoice lines by tomorrow noon.
dara (legal): I'll circulate SOW + voucher T&Cs by next Mon.
leo (partnerships): Action list: 1) Omar: SKU mapping + invoice sample (tomorrow noon). 2) Dara: SOW + voucher T&Cs (next Mon). 3) Nina: console partner_id + voucher flow JIRA (today). 4) Mike: confirm billing snapshot acceptance criteria (Fri). 5) Tara: confirm pilot partner and timeline (EOD).
tara (sales): ack, sharing partner contact now.
mike (product): ack, will validate ETL changes and reply with edge cases.
omar (finance): ack.
dara (legal): ack.
leo (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If no objections to voucher expiry (120d) or renewal safety-net, I'll formalize into a private-offer draft and loop in marketplace ops. DM me if you want adjustments. :white_check_mark:
